text:
I've lived in this Maccas. I've been dragged out of this Maccas. I've hung out at this Maccas. I've eaten at this Maccas. I have early childhood memories of this Maccas. Yet another McDonald’s joint... this place has gone through many facelifts and is set to go through yet another soon. I don't really eat here much anymore, but I find it to be very intimidating to navigate and stand to wait for what I ordered due to the door maiden being extra demanding and bossy.

I get a very nostalgic feeling from this place whenever I go. Usually years go by between visits and I'm always surprised both at seeing the new shopfront and changes made as well as how much it has stayed the same. Most of my favorite burgers have long split the scene. No matter how much things change here or what comes or goes, there's always something for everyone here.

I suppose when I'm 70 if I still live here in the 09, I'll probably start walking around the Maccas at 5am until it opens... do they still do that? I don't know.
author: David He

text:
I ordered delivery through Uber Eats. Very simple to order but very complicated to make it.
I removed cheese and lettuce from my Big Mac and it’s so simple to do it, and I received a lot of lettuce and cheese but no pickles. Not to mention that they didn’t place not even one napkin neither straw for Coca Cola. So regardless of having options to customize as maybe you are lactose intolerant or you have allergy on something, they’ll make it how they feel like and you gonna waste your money. It’s so hard to read what customer really wants!
Food was also cold and like it was hanging there for a while what actually receipt can confirm. I made order at 19:32:57 and the food I got was prepared at 19:31:08 and I got it delivered at 20:05.

text: This place is outrageous. You should avoid at all costs. I needed wheelchair accessable bathrooms. You have to purchase food or drinks to be able to unlock toilets..not ideal if you are in a hurry to go. I had planned on going to bathroom and getting comfortable then eating on a recent trip there. Couldn't use bathrooms because STAFF were in the disabled toilet. They use them as they are larger. Meanwhile disabled people on the outside waiting who had to literally pay to use them couldn't. Staff made no apologies. Disgusting behaviour. You need to do better. You should be ashamed.
author: Anita Jones

text: Not sure who is incharge of this place on the weekends but it was left in an absolute disgusting state and it was only 3:00pm.
